title: Radiant Exodus
description:
Are we truly evolving.. or just surviving?
Is the path we’ve chosen as a species the right one… or a dead end?

The Exodus Project was meant to reshape us, to build a stronger, better world.
To create superhumans.
To save us.

But something went wrong.
Terribly wrong.
And now, what was meant to save us is tearing us apart.Radiant Exodus is a linear action-horror shooter about loss, survival, and the will to fight back. 
You play as Sarah Caldwell, a former soldier trying to reconnect with a friend .. but the night has other plans. The city slips into darkness. People disappear. Blood paints the sidewalks. And something.. looms in the sky.

Her father might be in danger. The world feels like it’s ending. All she has is an old rifle, her training, and a promise she’s not willing to break.

This isn’t just survival. It’s a last stand. 
Key Features:

• Tight, linear campaign : No filler. Just raw action, eerie tension, and story-driven progression.

• Cinematic atmosphere : Dynamic lighting, haunting environments, and a world falling apart around you.. 

• Survival-focused combat : Manage your ammo, stay alert, and face off against twisted, relentless enemies.

• Unfold a mystery : Uncover fragments of a hidden truth through notes, transmissions, and moments of quiet dread.
description_short: A quiet night turns to horror as strange lights fill the sky and Gleam City falls apart. Play as Sarah, an ex-soldier fighting to survive, searching for her missing father, and facing something the world wasn't meant to see.
